review.notes:
Chain starts at v4 (SDGR-EN019, 2014-10-16), the version the pre-errata cdb text matches at 0.9918 - it differs only in a comma for a semicolon after 'you control' and 'ATK/DEF' for 'ATK and DEF'. Versions v0 (RDS-EN011, 2004-12-01) through v4 are behaviourally identical: each carries the 1-Union Condition, the face-up Attack Position Special Summon and the 'equipped by this effect' gain, so the earlier transitions (dropping 'during your Main Phase' and 'if you control this monster on the field', then the PSCT 'Target 1 ...; equip this card to that target' rewrite, whose targeting is the EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET already present in the shared union procedure) are cosmetic and are not recorded. The printing current at the Edison snapshot was v2 (SDMM-EN012, 2010-02-19) and at GOAT was v0, so the single recorded 2016 change puts both snapshots on the baseline correctly. Note the oldprotect argument is false in the pre-errata call, so proc_union's UnionReplace covers destruction by battle or effect in BOTH versions - the v5 wording 'destroyed by battle or card effect' only spells out what v4's unqualified 'would be destroyed' already did, and is not part of the behavioural change.

Round 037 (2026-09-29). Checked against period rulings: the differences the functional transition claims were searched for in the Konami-hosted UDE card FAQ (2008-12), the 2005 UDE card rulings page, Konami's errata lists, rulebooks and per-set ruling documents, and the archived UDE judge-list threads Yugipedia points to (the transition's rulings_check; docs/research/text-only-errata-audit.md, Heavy Mech Support Platform). The rulings read support d1, d3 at both snapshots (the passages are in the check); nothing contradicts a claimed difference, so kind, summary and coverage are unchanged. Verdicts: [event] d1 supported at Edison, supported at Tengu; d2 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu; d3 supported at Edison, supported at Tengu.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (SDKS-EN008, Structure Deck: Seto Kaiba); EdisonFormat.com independently attributes the removal of the Union Condition to the same 2016 Structure Deck

event.historical_text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK and DEF. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)
event.modern_text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 500 ATK and DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.
event.summary: Functional erratum: the parenthetical Condition 'A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time' was removed and the ATK/DEF gain was rebound from 'While equipped by this effect' to 'A monster equipped with this card'. Upstream encodes the old state as aux.AddUnionProcedure(c,filter,true,false) plus e1:SetCondition(aux.IsUnionState): with oldequip=true the equip target must carry no other Union monster (proc_union's UnionFilter takes the ct1==0 branch and the card registers EFFECT_OLDUNION_STATUS), the unequip/Special Summon requires the union state and forces face-up Attack Position, and the +500 ATK/DEF applies only while the card is equipped by its own Union effect. The modern call passes no old-rule flags, so a monster may carry several Union monsters, the Special Summon takes any face-up position, and the +500 applies whenever a monster is equipped with this card by any means.

rulings_check.difference: Era: a monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time (a Condition, so Heavy Mech cannot be equipped to a monster already carrying a Union monster); modern: no such limit. Era: unequipping it Special Summons it in face-up Attack Position; modern: it can be Special Summoned in any face-up position. Era: the +500 ATK/DEF applies only 'while equipped by this effect' (equipped by its own Union effect); modern: any monster equipped with this card gains it, however it was equipped.
